g.text: Evidence Model, Provenance and Decision States

text.tspan: The additive register is generated before and after cluster annotation: domain-dependent evidence is pending_cluster before annotation and refreshed afterward.
Scientific values are copied from their source tables; unavailable metadata is marked explicitly and is not inferred silently.
nearest edge - distance - class - threshold policy
source table + row - model link - run reports
created - processing - results ready / partial - failed
available - not applicable - pending - scientifically unavailable
exploratory or validated | primary result or review / missing
